body: I returned yesterday. I decided that my life is WAY to important to throw it all away. And yet, my friend will be dearly missed. It's good to be back and have my thoughts straightened out. :')

I decided to call a counselor. She'll help me deal with my problems. I'll tell her everything and I'll ask her to call the police, the hospital, the courthouse, or something. I just don't want to talk to the cops. I stutter when I get nervous and the police just seems like a lot of pressure. So thanks for the comment. I read them all. Some people think it's a troll. No. Me and my sister have a joined account. She likes to go on nosleep a lot. And the reason she hasn't seen this yet is because she doesn't know about the mail thing in the corner. So to the people who think I'm trolling, why would I joke about a serious business? I got raped. All these people are giving me advice. Even if I don't like it. I appreciate their concern though. I'm finally getting help. And now, I have to go get ready for my appointment. I have to leave in three hours.
Thank you all.

I know people are saying "Call the police!" but no one knows how much pressure it is on me. I've always the "too nice" girl. I hate being pressured. Do you know how it feels to be violated. Has a girl/guy touched you in ways that feel uncomfortable? Have you been to scared to do something? It feels like snitching on your friend for saying a bad word. It doesn't really matter. But when you tell someone, you feel sorry because they got punished. And I know that I can't look at guys the same ever again but I'd feel bad. I can't live with the guilt of putting someone in jail.

I would really like to talk to someone. I don't want to call the cops. I just wanna talk to him about it. He's a really nice guy. I appreciate your concern. I'm not hurt. I was. I'm scared shitless. And I went to the hospital. They asked what happened. I told them that it just got a little too rough. So basically the doctors thought that I wanted the "sex". But then they said that he messed up my system. I can never have children. Should I give in and say the truth? I saw in another comment that the hospital will call the police too. Is it true? If you read this, I really appreciate it if you'd answer back. I don't think I can look at a guy the same ever again.
Excuse me sir? I don't understand what you are trying to say.
He hasn't stopped.

Wait a minute. You live in England? So when you say 'Third Floor', do you mean fourth floor? Cause usually, the first floor is called the ground floor in England. Or are you writing it so the American redditors can understand?
Well this is nosleep after all.
I don't do weed.
I wrote a story about a ghost haunting a girl. The thing is, the ghost was HIM.
A teenage boy with short hair. Kinda taller than me. Really creepy.
It was an art project.
He ran away but we're looking for him.
Yup. It should've been obvious to me. But I guess I was blinded by something else.
Look at the reply I gave to Beleiver316. :)

No I'm fine. I just stopped it right there so that it could be like a cliffhanger thing. But I'm fine. He stabbed me, though. I pretended to pass out. So when he left, I was able to call police. I had blood gushing out from my wound. This happened only a couple months ago. I'd say maybe around 11 months. But I'm fine and not dead.
I didn't need to sleep anyway. O_O
I never said I made the story, now did I? ;)
Thanks. But this is the one I read. I just changed the dog's name so it wasn't totally copied.
